LanguageData.Gun_Winchester_M1897_Trench_RWP.label: Winchester M1897 Trench
LanguageData.Gun_Winchester_M1897_Trench_RWP.descript: The Winchester M1897 Trench is a pump-action shotgun known for its reliability in close-quarters combat. With a high rate of fire and formidable stopping power, it excels in short-range encounters. Originally designed for military use, its rugged construction and ability to mount a bayonet make it a versatile weapon for both offense and defense. Perfect for colonists facing frequent skirmishes or manning defensive chokepoints.
